description: This Java class 'IntentBuilderView' provides a UI component for building and configuring Android intents with various flags and target activities, allowing users to launch activities with customized intent configurations.

classes.name: IntentBuilderView
classes.description: A custom Android view for constructing intents with configurable flags and target activities, supporting user interaction and intent launching.

methods.name: currentIntent
methods.description: Constructs and returns an Intent object based on user-selected flags and target activity.

methods.name: startForResult
methods.description: Determines whether the intent should be started for a result based on UI selection.

methods.name: selectFlags
methods.description: Selects checkboxes corresponding to a list of flag names or IntentFlag objects.

methods.name: getAllCheckBoxes
methods.description: Retrieves all CheckBox views within the flag builder layout.

methods.name: childrenOfGroup
methods.description: Utility method to retrieve children of a specific type from a ViewGroup.

methods.name: getCheckedFlags
methods.description: Returns all IntentFlag objects associated with checked checkboxes.

methods.name: disableFlags
methods.description: Disables checkboxes associated with given flags.

methods.name: getCheckBox
methods.description: Finds the checkbox associated with a specific IntentFlag.
